summary: Web app that generates customer budgets/quotes (orçamentos) with print/PDF support.

existing_features.title: Update the orçamento print/PDF generation so that every generated output always includes an extra A4 page appended after the orçamento page containing exactly the user-provided Portuguese text “CONDIÇÕES GERAIS DE VENDA E GARANTIA …” (verbatim, preserving line breaks and bullet structure as much as possible).

If an additional image page is currently appended via imagemAdicional, ensure the new “General Terms” page is still always present and that page ordering is deterministic: orçamento page first, then the new terms page, then (if present) the imagemAdicional page.

new_feature_requests.summary: Add an extra page after every orçamento in the printed/PDF output containing the provided 'Condições Gerais de Venda e Garantia' text (always appended to all budgets).

projectName: Append a mandatory “General Terms of Sale and Warranty” page to every orçamento PDF/printout
